"""Tests for fmtcsv."""

from fmtcsv import format_summary, main, summarize_csv


def write_csv(tmp_path, content, name="data.csv"):
    file_path = tmp_path / name
    file_path.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
    return str(file_path)


def test_basic_counts(tmp_path):
    path = write_csv(tmp_path, "name,age\nalice,30\nbob,25\n")
    rows, columns, first = summarize_csv(path)
    assert rows == 2
    assert columns == 2
    assert first == ["alice", "30"]


def test_quoted_field_with_comma(tmp_path):
    path = write_csv(tmp_path, 'name,note\n"Doe, Jane","said ""hi"""\n')
    rows, columns, first = summarize_csv(path)
    assert rows == 1
    assert columns == 2
    assert first == ["Doe, Jane", 'said "hi"']


def test_spaces_inside_quotes_preserved(tmp_path):
    path = write_csv(tmp_path, 'a,b\n"  padded  ",plain\n')
    _, _, first = summarize_csv(path)
    assert first == ["  padded  ", "plain"]


def test_quoted_field_with_comma_and_spaces(tmp_path):
    path = write_csv(tmp_path, 'a,b\n"x , y , z","  lead and trail  "\n')
    rows, columns, first = summarize_csv(path)
    assert rows == 1
    assert columns == 2
    assert first == ["x , y , z", "  lead and trail  "]


def test_empty_file(tmp_path):
    path = write_csv(tmp_path, "")
    rows, columns, first = summarize_csv(path)
    assert (rows, columns, first) == (0, 0, None)


def test_header_only(tmp_path):
    path = write_csv(tmp_path, "x,y,z\n")
    rows, columns, first = summarize_csv(path)
    assert (rows, columns, first) == (0, 3, None)


def test_format_summary_and_cli(tmp_path, capsys):
    path = write_csv(tmp_path, 'h1,h2\n"v,1","  spaced  "\n')
    exit_code = main([path])
    out = capsys.readouterr().out
    assert exit_code == 0
    assert "Total rows: 1" in out
    assert "Total columns: 2" in out
    assert "First data row: ['v,1', '  spaced  ']" in out


def test_format_summary_empty():
    text = format_summary(0, 0, None)
    assert text == (
        "Total rows: 0\nTotal columns: 0\nFirst data row: None"
    )


def test_quoted_comma_field_is_single_column(tmp_path):
    path = write_csv(tmp_path, 'name,age,city\n"Doe, Jane",30,"Springfield, IL"\n')
    rows, columns, first = summarize_csv(path)
    assert rows == 1
    assert columns == 3
    assert first == ["Doe, Jane", "30", "Springfield, IL"]
